name: How long does it take to convert a standard bathtub or shower to a curbless system?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to convert a standard bathtub or shower to a curbless system?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical curbless shower conversion takes about two to three weeks to complete from start to finish. Demolition and subfloor inspection occur first, followed by structural joist adjustments and plumbing rough-ins. Next comes the application of a continuous, water-tested waterproofing membrane, which must cure completely before tile setting begins. Custom tile cutting, grouting, finish carpentry, and glass panel installation make up the final stages. Timelines can extend if you select custom-fabricated glass enclosures, specialty imported tile, or if hidden subfloor moisture damage is discovered during demolition that requires immediate repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard curbless shower conversion usually takes two to three weeks, depending on structural adjustments, waterproofing cure times, and custom tile installation.
